integrity: Every three-edge geodesic of the crown graph corresponds bijectively to a transitive directed triangle under the encoding a_i b_j <-> i -> j. For each arc u -> v in a transitive-triangle-free digraph, both the out-neighborhoods and the in-neighborhoods of u and v are disjoint. Summing the resulting degree inequalities over all arcs and applying Cauchy--Schwarz gives at most floor(n^2/2) arcs. A balanced bidirected cut has exactly floor(n^2/2) arcs and contains no transitive triangle. An independent exhaustive checker confirms the exact maxima for n=3,4,5.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the maximum size, not the complete family of maximum edge general position sets.
The small cases Cr_3 congruent to C_6 and Cr_4 congruent to Q_3 are already covered by published cycle and hypercube results.
The finite exhaustive verification is limited to n=3,4,5 and is corroborative only.
The theorem is specific to deleting a perfect matching from K_{n,n}.
A differently phrased or non-indexed crown result may exist despite targeted searches.
title: Edge general position number of crown graphs
